clips.title: The story
paras: Darthalia's Sealed Commendation is an official dispatch penned by the Forsaken battle commander in Tarren Mill. It praises a soldier's relentless campaign against the humans of Hillsbrad and delivers word of those victories directly to Undercity's high command.

Following the brutal clashes across the Hillsbrad Foothills, High Executor Darthalia drafted this sealed dispatch to officially record victories against Hillsbrad's human defenders and the devastation wrought upon human positions. Sealed to preserve the commander's appraisal from prying eyes, the document is addressed to Varimathras, dreadlord advisor to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner. For the Forsaken leadership in the Royal Quarter, such missives offer tangible proof that Alliance enclaves south of Lordaeron can be broken, freeing northern garrisons to focus on the relentless threat of the Scourge.
